title: System Admin Dashboard
description: System Admin Dashboard documentation for System Admin.
overview: This guide covers system admin dashboard workflows for System Admin.

subtasks.title: Review the Enrollment Summary
subtasks.purpose: Get a portfolio-wide snapshot of practices, patients, and programs the System Admin oversees.

steps.title: Land on Dashboard
steps.description: Sign in and land on the Dashboard by default.

steps.title: Read Summary Cards
steps.description: Read the three cards at the top: Total Practices, Total Patients, Total Programs.

steps.title: Confirm Sub-Badge Counts
steps.description: Confirm the sub-badges (A#, P#, L#) match the practices the System Admin manages.

steps.title: Scroll to Practice List
steps.description: Scroll down to reach the Practice List table for drill-in.

subtasks.title: Filter and open a practice
subtasks.purpose: Locate a specific practice from the visible portfolio and open its detail page.

steps.title: Filter the Practice List
steps.description: Use the Search practices… box, or use the Status, Locations, Patient Range, or Programs dropdowns to narrow the list.

steps.title: Sort by Column
steps.description: Sort by clicking any column header (Status, Practice, Total Patients, Program Enrolled).

steps.title: Open Practice Detail
steps.description: Click the blue eye (view) icon in the Action column on a practice row.

steps.title: Land on Practice Tab
steps.description: The practice detail view opens at the Practice tab. System Admin sees only practices they are assigned to, unlike Super Admin who sees all. Task 6.2 — Practice Detail
